## The Short Version

After many months studying neurons, I have come to believe a network's own mechanisms are its legible building blocks. See the [appendix](/appendix#notes) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neuron).

![](figures/city.png)

## Details

The first approach is **rapid** normal science on the network itself. The second is to untangle the network before studying it, which costs far more and has not paid off yet.
